thought.text: All four services are up. Now the critical end-to-end check: obtain a token from Keycloak and use it against the backend API, plus verify Keycloak client configuration.

reasoning_content:
All services are running:
- Keycloak: 302 on root (redirect to login page)
- Frontend: 200
- Backend: Swagger 200, API returns 401 without a token (auth is working)

Next, I need to validate the following:
1. Keycloak's client configuration (realm, client, roles, redirect URIs, flows)
2. Database tables
3. End-to-end authentication: get a token and call the API
4. CORS check
5. Frontend configuration

Let me do the end-to-end authentication test first — this is the strongest evidence. I'll get a token via direct access grant, then call /api/Strasse.

action.command: TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:8080/realms/my-realm/protocol/openid-connect/token" -d "grant_type=password&client_id=strassennamen&username=user1&password=user1pass" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['access_token'])") && echo "Token obtained: ${TOKEN:0:30}..." && echo "=== Token roles ===" && curl -s "http://localhost:8080/realms/my-realm/protocol/openid-connect/token" -d "grant_type=password&client_id=strassennamen&username=user1&password=user1pass" | python3 -c "import sys,json; t=json.load(sys.stdin)['access_token']; import base64; p=t.split('.')[1]; p+='='*(-len(p)%4); d=json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(p)); print('resource_access:', json.dumps(d.get('resource_access',{}).get('strassennamen',{})))" && echo "=== API with token ===" && curl -s -w "\nHTTP %{http_code}\n" --max-time 15 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://localhost:5000/api/Strasse"
